shape: E-shape (vertical spine on west, three arms going east)
description: E-shaped layout with a vertical spine along the west side and three arms extending east. The spine runs north-south at X≈-12, joining the spine anchors p7kn6i (north end) → c217jr (middle) → i93oeu (south end). Three arms branch east: a NORTH arm running to mjad8x (dead-end), a MIDDLE arm running through 58pmly to spawn_east, and a SOUTH arm running through ho8mcg. The west portal sits at the north end of the spine; the south portal sits at the south end of the spine.

portals.south: spawn_south at (-14.99, 22.79) — south end of the spine area
portals.east: spawn_east at (22.86, -2.04) — east end of the MIDDLE arm
portals.west: spawn_west at (-22.85, -12.96) — west side, joining the north end of the spine

anchors.description: spine north end — joins west arm + north arm (matches p7kn6i)
spine middle — joins middle arm (matches c217jr)
spine south end — joins south arm + south gate (matches i93oeu)
NORTH arm east end — DEAD-END pocket (matches mjad8x)

traversalNotes: E-SHAPE BACKBONE: vertical spine (spine_north → spine_mid → spine_south) with three east-going arms branching off each spine node. The west and south portals attach directly to the spine; the east portal is at the tip of the middle arm.
Direct west ↔ south: spawn_west → spine_north → spine_mid → spine_south → spawn_south.
Direct west ↔ east: spawn_west → spine_north → spine_mid → mid_arm_e → spawn_east. The middle arm's east end (mid_arm_e) is the last authored anchor before spawn_east.
Direct south ↔ east: spawn_south → spine_south → spine_mid → mid_arm_e → spawn_east.

MISSING EDGE NOTE: the authored graph as currently committed has no edge between mid_arm_e (58pmly) and spawn_east. The solver / autopilot will need this added to actually traverse via the middle arm — flag if the autopilot reaches mid_arm_e and stalls. Author probably intended it as a straight axis-aligned leg; can be added in a follow-up paste.
NORTH arm is a DEAD-END pocket (mjad8x has no portal). Routing to mjad8x: enter spine_north → mjad8x → reverse. Same dispatch-via-spine rule as the other arms.

DISPATCH RULE: arm-side objectives route via the arm's east-end anchor (north_arm_e / mid_arm_e / south_arm_e), which is the child of the spine node for that arm. Don't cross the spine to dispatch — pick the same-arm anchor.
Stages are never physically rotated — all positions are stage-local mesh-space XZ.
